name: smwmusic-crash-nitro-kart-assembly-lane
title: Crash Nitro Kart - Assembly Lane
description:
An intense industrial theme that plays in Assembly Lane, a factory themed track.

You can define in the .txt file which variation you want to use:
0 - Default in-game version
1 - In-game version but with the addition of the drum intro from CTR Nitro-Fueled (0x09A9)
